questions.q: Which structure would you use to store one customer record with labeled fields such as id and name?
questions.explain: A dictionary stores values under keys, which makes it the natural shape for a single record.

questions.q: With totals = [20.0, 55.5, 130.0, 8.25], what does totals[1:3] return?
questions.explain: A slice includes the start position (1) and stops before the end position (3), so it returns the items at positions 1 and 2.

questions.q: x = [1, 2, 3]; y = x; y.append(4). What is x afterwards?
questions.explain: y = x makes both names point to the same list, so changing y changes x. Use x.copy() for an independent list.
